name: Rehlet Zahab
overview: Follows the lives of Yemeni immigrants and expatriates in Egypt after the outbreak of war in Yemen and the closure of airports through the story of Waheba, an expatriate in Egypt who reunites the Yemenis there and helps them with her son Sami and her daughter Sara.
